questions: Should the random integer be added to the total count of occurrences (len(positions)), or should it be added to each individual occurrence count (e.g., per position)?
Is the random integer generated once per function call and added to the total count, or generated per occurrence?

Should the random integer be added to the count before or after counting occurrences, i.e., is it count + random or random + count (order doesn't matter mathematically but could affect type/sequence)?
If the dictionary keys are numeric, should they be treated as strings or kept as their original numeric type for column names?
Should the row-index in the output tuples be integer indices (as in DataFrame .iloc) or label-based (as in .loc) if the DataFrame has a custom index?
If the item appears multiple times in the same column, should the output list order follow column-major (column then row) or row-major order?
Should the function handle nested dictionaries or only flat dictionaries where values are lists?
Is the seed parameter used only for the random integer generation, or should it also seed any other randomness (e.g., if Faker is used in tests)?
